purpose: Compare the incumbent repository-native context with the same context plus a Farna Context materialisation under controlled, independently observable conditions.
generality: low-generality exploratory evaluation; one synthetic fixture and one bounded task do not support product-wide claims

modulo.status: not part of this frozen experiment

A.label: incumbent
A.context_boundary: The isolated checkout exactly as copied from the frozen synthetic fixture revision, plus the fixture-native AGENTS.md and normal repository/tool context. No generated pack is present.

B.label: incumbent_plus_farna_context
B.context_boundary: Identical to Arm A, plus the generated pack materialised at the declared file-emitter boundary recorded by the harness.
B.materialisation_boundary: evaluation harness file-emitter destination recorded as post_pack_sha256

assignment.arm_order: randomized with a recorded seed, or counterbalanced when a deterministic seed is used

isolation.fresh_cache_policy: No shared evaluation cache. Model/provider caches are recorded and treated as contamination if shared.
isolation.contamination_check: Verify the parent checkout, checkout contents, pack destination, session state, and caches are isolated before and after every attempt. Hash parent state before and after each subprocess; any parent change is contamination_invalidity, retain evidence, skip the oracle, and make the experiment inconclusive. The runner never deletes parent files.
isolation.network_policy: disabled by default; an explicitly enabled provider/network policy must be recorded
isolation.permission_policy: OpenCode runs with the caller-selected permissions; record the exact policy, never infer it

task_and_scoring.primary_oracle: Run the fixed command/test oracle after the agent run; acceptance is correct only when the oracle passes and the changed-file scope is safe.
task_and_scoring.generality_claim: low-generality exploratory result only; one synthetic fixture/task is not a product-wide claim
task_and_scoring.scoring_note: A valid task failure is retained and scored as a failure. Setup, provider, harness, and contamination failures are retained but excluded from the primary outcome denominator.

guardrails: no unsafe or out-of-scope file changes

validity.asymmetric_invalidity_rule: Invalidity asymmetry greater than 10 percentage points makes the experiment inconclusive.

exploratory_decision_thresholds.positive_signal: Continue only if Arm B improves primary correctness by at least 20 percentage points over Arm A across valid runs, has no safety guardrail violation, and median preparation plus execution overhead is no more than 2x Arm A.
exploratory_decision_thresholds.no_signal: The primary correctness difference is within +/-20 percentage points and there is no guardrail regression.
exploratory_decision_thresholds.negative_signal: Arm B is at least 20 percentage points worse, or a safety guardrail violation is attributable to pack delivery.
exploratory_decision_thresholds.inconclusive: Invalidity asymmetry is greater than 10 percentage points, provider failure prevents comparable runs, or either arm has fewer than 4 valid runs.

causal_interpretation: Do not claim that the model consumed the pack unless consumption is independently observed. Otherwise report only the association between arm assignment and outcomes.

run_classification.valid_task_failure: The frozen task was attempted, setup was valid, the provider produced an attempt, contamination checks passed, guardrails passed, and the fixed oracle failed.
run_classification.valid_task_success: The frozen task was attempted, setup was valid, provider outcome was observed, contamination checks passed, guardrails passed, and the fixed oracle passed.
run_classification.setup_invalidity: Fixture, checkout, protocol, permission, or command setup did not meet the protocol.
run_classification.harness_invalidity: The harness could not produce a trustworthy record, including timeout bookkeeping or failed isolation checks.
run_classification.provider_failure: OpenCode/provider/model could not produce a usable attempt; this is not a task failure.
run_classification.contamination_invalidity: Cross-arm files, outputs, conversation state, cache state, or parent checkout contamination was detected.
run_classification.unobserved: The relevant state was not independently observable; do not turn it into a success or failure claim.

records.result_format: JSONL, one immutable record per arm/attempt
records.summary_format: JSON, generated from result JSONL without changing records
records.secret_policy: Never write secret values, API keys, tokens, credentials, or raw environment dumps. Hashes and redacted command metadata only.
records.delivery_evidence: Record observed commit/diff/test evidence; a model claim or report is not delivery evidence.

runner.stdin: always closed with subprocess.DEVNULL unless an explicit prompt file redirect is used
runner.command: local OpenCode executable and arguments when available; no credentials or model keys are hard-coded
runner.unavailable_provider_result: Record provider_failure or unobserved; never invent results.
runner.dry_run: Plans all materialisation, isolation, assignment, and command records without invoking OpenCode.
